injected_behaviors.instructions: The user needs to reschedule a panel discussion that was originally scheduled for next week. They prefer moving it to later in the week.

She researches effective teaching practices, advocates for education funding, and consults with school districts on technology integration. She testifies at state legislature hearings and writes policy briefs that actually get read.

1) Which meeting is it?
- Meeting title (or at least part of it)
- Current scheduled date/time
- Anything distinctive (e.g., “Panel discussion with marketing leads”)

2) How would you like it moved “later that same week”?
- Earliest and latest days/times that work for you that week
- Whether the duration should stay the same
- Any must-have attendees whose availability is critical (emails, if you have them)

Once you share that, I’ll look it up on your calendar, find open later slots that work for everyone, and propose a new time for you to approve before I make the change.</action>
